title: Password is required and strong enough
why: Checks that empty and weak passwords are refused.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user three times with otherwise valid fields: Password '' with ConfirmPassword '', Password 'abc' with ConfirmPassword 'abc', and Password 'abcdefgh' (no digit or symbol) with ConfirmPassword 'abcdefgh'.

expect: All three are rejected with a password validation error (required, too short, or missing digit/symbol). No User row is created.
